en_title: Dan Houser Reveals Rockstar’s Struggle to Make Bully
subtitle: 没有汽车和枪，玩什么？
opus_summary: 《恶霸鲁尼》编剧Dan Houser回忆，开发团队既要摸索校园玩法，也要应对争议，游戏直到很晚才成形。课程安排和校园恶作剧让团队逐渐找到了方向。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar is gearing up for the launch of GTA 6, but, of course, Grand Theft Auto isn’t the only series the developer is known for. Alongside the likes of the beloved Red Dead Redemption games, there are many fans of another open-world adventure from the studio: Bully.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar正在为《GTA6》的发售做准备，不过，这家开发商的知名系列当然不只有《侠盗猎车手》。除了备受喜爱的《荒野大镖客：救赎》等作品，工作室旗下的另一款开放世界冒险游戏《恶霸鲁尼》也拥有众多粉丝。

paragraphs.en: Released in 2006 and originally known in Europe as Canis Canem Edit, Bully tells the story of unruly student Jimmy Hopkins getting in and out of trouble during a year at Bullworth Academy. A smaller-scale, less X-rated version of GTA, it launched to critical acclaim. But the road towards launch was far from easy.
paragraphs.cn: 《恶霸鲁尼》于2006年发售，最初在欧洲以《Canis Canem Edit》为名推出。游戏讲述了桀骜不驯的学生Jimmy Hopkins在Bullworth Academy度过一年的故事，其间他不断惹上麻烦，又设法脱身。这款游戏就像是规模更小、成人内容更少的《侠盗猎车手》，发售后广受好评。但它走向发售的过程远非一帆风顺。

paragraphs.en: “The development was hard,” former Rockstar VP and writer of Bully, Dan Houser, said in a new interview as part of our IGN30 Icons Series. “The game was in trouble all of the time. It was difficult. It was an out-there concept. We were struggling with it. I wasn't sure it was going to be any good. We really wanted it to come together. It was really fun afterwards because it came together really well. The team did a great job. It was a sort of really strong game at the end. It kind of came together very late.”
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar前副总裁、《恶霸鲁尼》编剧Dan Houser在IGN30 Icons系列的一次新采访中表示：「开发过程很艰难。这款游戏一直麻烦不断，做起来很难。它的概念很不寻常，我们做得很吃力。我当时不确定它能不能做好。我们真的很希望它能成形。后来就很开心了，因为各个部分最终结合得非常好。团队干得很出色。最终做出来的游戏相当出色，只是到了很晚才成形。」

paragraphs.en: Houser went on to explain why the development of Bully proved such a challenge, coming as it did just over a year after GTA: San Andreas. “New IP is very stressful because you're doing something that no one's ever done before,” he said. “And particularly that game, there was all of this controversy around it to do with the name, or people misunderstood it when they'd never seen it. So I think one of the challenges with that game was it never got the attention it deserved. We were too focused on trying to at least get people to stock it or to not protest it before it even came out.”
paragraphs.cn: 《恶霸鲁尼》在《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》发售一年多后推出，Houser接着解释了它的开发为何如此艰难。他说：「做新IP压力很大，因为你在做从来没人做过的东西。尤其是这款游戏，光是名字就引发了各种争议，还有人根本没见过游戏就误解了它。所以我觉得，这款游戏面临的一个难题是，它始终没有得到应有的关注。我们把太多精力放在了争取让商家至少愿意上架这款游戏，或是让人们别在游戏发售前就抗议它。」

paragraphs.en: The mid-2000s was an era when controversy followed Rockstar games whenever one was about to hit store shelves, whether it be the snuff-film-fuelled ultraviolence of Manhunt, or the sex minigame mod, Hot Coffee, uncovered in the code of San Andreas. Bully was no different, with some members of the public worried about how its explicit content would translate into a school setting.
paragraphs.cn: 在2000年代中期，Rockstar的游戏每逢即将上架，总会伴随着争议。无论是《Manhunt》中以杀人实录影片为题材的极端暴力，还是在《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》代码中发现的性爱小游戏模组「热咖啡」，都曾引发风波。《恶霸鲁尼》也不例外，一些公众担心，这类露骨内容放到校园背景下会如何呈现。

paragraphs.en: “There was huge hysteria around it,” Houser stated. “We had to spend most of 2006 diffusing it, so we couldn't positively promote the game in the way we normally would've done. I think that didn't help it. I mean, that was the same time as Hot Coffee, and it felt like things were imploding. It was very stressful. And just go to work each day, wonder who's protesting you that day, and hope that things can shake out properly. I wasn't directly involved. Luckily, I was just sort of right off to the side, and wasn't directly involved in organizing most of that stuff. But it was really stressful for the people involved.”
paragraphs.cn: Houser表示：「围绕这款游戏，当时有非常严重的恐慌情绪。我们不得不花掉2006年的大部分时间去平息这些情绪，所以没法像往常那样正面宣传游戏。我觉得这对游戏没什么帮助。我的意思是，那时也正值‘热咖啡’风波，感觉一切都快崩溃了，压力非常大。每天去上班，都在想今天又是谁在抗议你，只希望事情最终能妥善解决。我没有直接参与。幸运的是，我基本处在边缘位置，没有直接参与组织其中大多数事务。但对参与其中的人来说，压力真的很大。」

paragraphs.en: But it wasn’t just external pressures that made the development of Bully difficult. Rockstar also had to wrestle with how to make its style of open-world action-adventure work from the perspective of a teenager. The school setting meant driving cars and shooting guns had to be parked to one side — two vital gameplay mechanics of any GTA.
paragraphs.cn: 但让《恶霸鲁尼》开发困难重重的并不只有外部压力。Rockstar还得琢磨，如何从青少年的视角出发，让自家风格的开放世界动作冒险玩法成立。校园背景意味着开车和开枪都得暂且放到一边——而这两种玩法在任何一部《侠盗猎车手》游戏中都至关重要。

paragraphs.en: “Developers were struggling with what the IP was, and we'd made some changes, and some people had moved out there from New York, and it was starting to get a bit better, but it was still really struggling,” revealed Houser. “It was really, well, if you take away the cars and you take away the guns, what is the game? What are you doing? And the lead designer, who was really talented, began to put in the schedule and began to put in the lessons, and it was starting to get there.
paragraphs.cn: Houser透露：「开发者一直没能理清这个IP到底该是什么样。我们做了一些调整，也有一些人从纽约搬到了那边，情况开始有些好转，但开发依然举步维艰。问题其实就是，如果去掉汽车，再去掉枪械，这到底是个什么游戏？玩家要做什么？后来，那位很有才华的首席设计师开始加入作息安排和课程，游戏才开始逐渐成形。

paragraphs.en: “Then, one of the designers put this thing where you could stick a Post-it note on the back of a character that said ‘Kick me’ on it. Then an NPC would run up and kick them. And just seeing that work, you're like, that's a great moment. So then you're, okay, we're starting to get somewhere. So I think that moment was probably when I always remember going, this IP that wouldn't work in a GTA, obviously; it's not interesting. But as a kid, and suddenly it was the scale of the school and the scale of a kid's life, it started to feel really fun.”
paragraphs.cn: 「后来，一位设计师加入了这样的玩法：你可以在一个角色背后贴上写着「踢我」的便利贴，然后就会有NPC跑过来踢他。光是看到这一幕真的发生，你就会觉得，这一刻太棒了。接着你就会想，好，我们开始找到方向了。所以我想，我一直记得自己大概就是在那一刻意识到：这种玩法放在《侠盗猎车手》里显然行不通，没什么意思。但当你扮演一个孩子，游戏的尺度突然变成了一所学校、一个孩子的生活时，它就开始显得非常有趣了。」

paragraphs.en: Bully was indeed very fun. So much so that fans have been begging for a sequel ever since. While ideas for a follow-up were once floated around at Rockstar, Houser revealed to IGN in 2025 that it never got off the ground due to “bandwidth issues.”
paragraphs.cn: 《恶霸鲁尼》确实非常好玩，粉丝们自那以后便一直盼着推出续作。Rockstar内部曾讨论过续作的构想，但Houser在2025年向IGN透露，由于「精力和资源有限」，续作始终未能启动。

paragraphs.en: I do miss the days when you’d get a new Rockstar open world to roam around in every year, but I guess at some point I have to give up yearning for the PS2 era. It was 20 years ago, after all. Luckily, Grand Theft Auto 6 is only weeks away from release.
paragraphs.cn: 我确实怀念每年都能在Rockstar打造的新开放世界里四处漫游的日子，但我想，总有一天我得放下对PS2时代的眷恋。毕竟，那已经是20年前了。好在《GTA6》距离发售只剩几周了。

paragraphs.en: For more on GTA 6, you can read our full interview with Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson , how the game will tackle the current political climate , and why Dan Houser says he won’t be playing it .
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多《GTA6》的消息，可以阅读我们对Rockstar工作室联合负责人Rob Nelson的完整采访，以及关于这款游戏将如何处理当前政治环境、Dan Houser为何表示自己不会玩这款游戏的报道。
